text.offer: You've beaten avars and their chieftains; now face what even the avars fear. The kriipa come up from the old places by the ruins - swift, armoured, deadly. Kill eight, and you'll have nothing left to learn from me.
text.progress: The kriipa roam the path to the ruins and the warrior avars' camps.
text.complete: Eight kriipa. You are as fine a warrior as this island has seen. Konima himself would have bowed to you.
